translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Rut Rmikatine Drpwr Nra Bali Kxyrlwrtxo
Mzli lcde, kzdq kc ncblo drtqde Boas mnc Betleem. Nide bcnyr x Naomi krlzle nide murde ngi kxngini ncblo ngrde.

Mz zbq kzble mz nourla, Rut rpibzle mz Naomi kx, “Rlr-ngrm bange nzvz-krnge mz lclr bali. Mwx kzdq ncblo kxmrlz sa na-abrtzlvzle nzrmikatine-krnge drpwr nra bali kxyrlwrtxo mrnyzde.” Rpibz Naomi bade kx, “Vz inyxnge, sa tqmrlz ye.”

Zbz Rut kc tqvzpe tqrmikatipe drpwr nra bali kx nzrlasztipe leplz kxnzawzng. Mz lclr bali lc, kzdung leplz nzrpakilzmqng bali, x kzdu-kzng leplz nzvz-nqblqlr nidr mz nztalvz-krdrleng. X mz nibr nzrtwz-krdr rtalvz kcng, nzkrlz leplz nzrmikatingr nra bali kxyrlwrtxo. Mz zbq lcdepwz, sc tqkrlztipele kx lclr bali kc nyz Boas.
Rut Rmctile Boas Mz Lclr Bali Nyzde

Mz nourla lcdepwz, Boas rkalzm Betleem x kaputrpz mz lclr bali nyzde. X sc tqrpipebzle mz kxnzawz nedeng amrlx kx, “Nimu la.” X nzayzlu-ngrbzlr natqde kx, “Nim la.” X rpi-mopwzle kx, “Rlxtibo mz Yawe kx naokatrle nimu.” X nzrpi-kzpzlr kx, “X nim kz!”
Boas kc tqveapebz mz ncblo kc tqaclvele kxnzawzng, rpibzle kx, “?Doa olvz lcmonr ne neke?”
Rpibz ncblo kc kx, “Krla doa olvz lr Moab, kx nzvzmqng mz Naomi, mz nzyzlu-krmle kc Moab.

Rpimle bange kx, ‘?Nzmu rlr-ngrme bange nzrmikatine-krbo nra bali mz nibrdr kxnzawzng?’ X sa tqbrngzti-zpwxle nzrmikatingr nra bali abzo-pnzle kcma mz nourla, x sa tqvzbe. A' amapx-ngrmle matelq mzli kx mrbcne.”
Zbz sc tqrpibz Boas mz Rut kx, “Lalztqm bange, kx inyxnge. Rpix naokatrpo nim. Bzkq rmikatiq nra bali mz nrlc nyz ncblo kzble x bzkq rlaszq mrka. A' mncamu badr olvi kxnzawz nengeng.

Mcpwz mrkc tzrpakingr ncblo lcng bali, x nim kc tqrmikanebzme mz nibr olvi kcng tzrtalvzng. Pipebo badr ncblo lcng kx bzkq nzesotrpzng bam. X drtwrm kx tqbrlxkzle, vz, x rmnqtr mz belue kcng tzangqbatipe ncblo kcng.”
Zbz, Rut yrngzobz bade mz drtc' mz nzamrluengr. X sc tqrpipebzle kx, “?Memule tqmrlzti-zlwz-ngrn ninge x tqamrlue-ngrn ninge? Murde ninge olvz lr narnrlc.”

Ayzlu-ngrbz Boas natqde kx, “Da amrlx kcng tqalebzme mz lxem Naomi, mz nibr nzbzkr mrlxde kc tqngi ncblo ngrm, nzyapwxtipem bange bq mz nibr nzkaputr-krmamu. X kxmu nzrlasz-krme trtem x lxem x mrnyzm, x vzme mz nzmnc-krmu badr leplz kx nqmq krdr blepx.
Rlxtibo mz Yawe, Gct rgr, kx na-ayzlubzle bamu nike aletiqng, mz nzamrlz-zlwz-krde nim. Nide ka tqmnclzpebzme bade mz nzvz-krme lc, x nide me rlakitrq, mz nzapu-krm nei kio kx mnclzbz mz nabx lxede.”
Rpibz Rut kx, “Trtenge, yc zlwz mz drtwrm ninge. X awxopeme nabznge mz nzycmne-nivzlrpe-krme lc bange, kxmule-esz' trmatqnewxu myaszlzle olvi nem kcng tzwztrpzng bam.”

Mzli kc namupengr bea, rpibz Boas mz Rut kx, “Vzm namupeku. X leo kz bret nam mz waen lc pipz.” Mzli kc Rut tqwxbutr-ngrbzle mz olvi kcng, Boas kabzle bade kcng bali kx nztqngq, mz nzapusr-krde nide kxmnctrpz bade. Rut mu x nelzde krlc. X nade kcng ycpwz.
Mzli kc Rut tqvz-ngrde mz nzrmika-mou-krde nra bali, rpibz Boas badr ncblo nedeng kx, “Nzmu kx tqrmika-abeanetrpzle me yrlwr ngr rtalvz ngr bali, bzkq amyabzmu drtqde, murde rlr-ngrbo bade.
A' vecpxbzmu du bali mz rtalvz ngrde kx namikatile x bzkq lclvzbzmu.”
Naomi X Rut Nzycmnetr-ngrdr Boas Nzngini-krde Kxnginidr Kx Takitrde Nzokatr-krde Nidr
Rut rmika bali mz lclr bali lc vz-krlzbzle milzpq. Zbz sc tqtalqtipele drpwr bali kcng tqmikatile. Nulvzole mz bxli x yrbulzm. X bxli lc takitr kilo kx nzpnu-esz'-nrade-tq.
Zbz sc tqglqpele bali kc mz mztea, x Naomi mcle bxli r bali kc etu tqglqmle. X ka-kzpz Rut dakxnzng kcng tqmutr-ngrde mzli kc bea.

Naomi rveabz kx, “?Mzbq ka drlve kc tqrmika-ngrn bali? Krka'-ngrne kx Gct na-amrlzle ncblo kc tqokatrle nim.” Zbz sc tqpipebz Rut mz lxede kx, “Drtq ncblo kc tqngi nyzde lclr bali kc tqwz-ngrne kcma, Boas.”

Rpibz Naomi bade kx, “Eu, rlxtibo mz Yawe kx na-amrlzle nide. Murde tresakiu nzbatr-krbzle nzrmrlznr-krde leplz kxnzlubeng x kxnzbzpeng. Ncblo la tqngi Boas, ngi kzdq kxnginigu kx takitrde nzxpepx-krde drtc' nyzgu x nzaopx-krde nqvi lr ncblo ngrgu.”
Zbz rpi-mopwz Rut kx, “Boas rpi-kzple bange kx, ‘Mncamu badr kxnzawz nengeng nakrlz-zpwxbzle nzyrkrpxkr nzrkqngr bali x wit.’”
Naomi rpibzle kx, “Inyxnge, mrlzvxitx nzvzne-krmu badr olvi nedeng, murde ma tzatrkam mz nrlc nyz ncblo kzble, mz nzngini-krm lr narnrlc kx esz'trpz badr.”
Mz zbq kang kqlu, Rut sc tqmnctr-zvzbz badr olvi kxnzawz ne Boas, mz nzrmikati-krde, vz vz mzli kx yrkrpxngr nzrkqngr bali x wit. X nzmncpwzng mz lvxbqde Naomi.

footnotes.text: Mz lou sc Mosis, kxrnginyz lclr da, narlr-ngrbzlr mz doa kx trnzrngiscung nzrmikatine-krdr nra da kx yrlwrtxo mz lclr da nyzdr. [Livae 19:9-10; 23:22]
